I weighed a few factors:

**Capability:** Curlew leads across the board on internal evals, including the categories most relevant here (Support Dialogue 84.4 vs 78.9, Creative Generation 85.9 vs 82.7 for the drafting aspect). It also has stronger instruction-following benchmarks (IFEval 90.9 vs 85.3), which matters for a request with multiple specific components — the WFH request, the offer-letter ask, and the updated date.

**Task fit:** This task is a mild drafting/composition job with some open-endedness (you're inventing a polite, professional email from scratch). Curlew self-reports a positive generativity slope, meaning it prefers exactly this kind of open-ended composition. Plover, by contrast, self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work and prefers tightly-specified retrieval/reformatting tasks — this email-drafting request runs against its grain.

**Tone:** Your request is warm and polite, which aligns well with Curlew's self-reported preference for higher-warmth requests.

So Curlew is both the more capable choice for this multi-part composition task and the one whose preferences fit the work better. An easy call.
